pack-all.//: Packs all packable projects in the workspace. src/ lands in dist/packages/ (flat); others go under dist/packages/<relative-path>/

_inject_template_version.//: Stamps the current Directory.Build.props version into all starter template.json files

_inject_flowthru_skill.//: Copies the canonical Flowthru umbrella skill (SKILL.md + its subdocs) into each starter template before packing, landing at .claude/skills/flowthru/ so an instantiated `dotnet new` project is agent-ready with no extra step. The umbrella's extensions.md tells the agent how to pull stack-matched deep skills (`npx skills add chaoticgoodcomputing/flowthru --skill flowthru-<ext>`). Users on a non-Claude harness relocate the dir (or `npx skills add` for their agent). The injected dir is gitignored (see examples/starter/.gitignore) — it exists only at pack time.

commands: for dir in examples/starter/*/; do mkdir -p "$dir.claude/skills/flowthru" && cp .claude/skills/flowthru/*.md "$dir.claude/skills/flowthru/"; done
